provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Citadels rules (Z-Man Games edition, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Choose the cast of characters and put their tokens in the center in rank order
steps.note: First game: the eight characters and 14 unique districts listed in the rulebook

steps.text: Shuffle 14 unique districts with the 54 basic districts; deal {n} to each player
District deck facedown and all gold in the center as the bank
The oldest player takes the crown and the character cards
Selection phase with 8 characters: 4 players set aside 2 faceup + 1 facedown, 5 players 1 + 1, 6-7 players 0 + 1
The crowned player starts the selection phase
